text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Are you two going to be alright?
It really has been quite a while
since I last asked you to watch the store.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There is no problem at all, Mother. We are the daughters of a liquor store owner, after all. We used to help out all the time in the past.

text_block_list.name: Hayahide's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how dependable! Well then, your father and I
are off to make our rounds of greetings for the
"Founding Anniversary Party."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Our shop's "Founding Anniversary Party"... So Mother and Father can focus entirely on preparations, we must proceed with our duties prudently to avoid any mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh... Is this "Fifty-Fourth Generation"? It is said to be an elusive, phantom sake. I must pack it meticulously so it doesn't break...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, one more layer of wrap. No, what if it's dropped and run over by a passing truck...? I should add two or three more layers just in case—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Hey, sis.
What's with that monstrosity of bubble wrap...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —What!? The expressway is congested!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Our delivery route uses local roads, but even so, the spillover traffic might reach us... A backup route... and a backup for the backup—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this road appears narrow... If an elderly person happens to be walking there, it could cause trouble. Very well, let us evaluate backup route number twelve—

text_block_list.name: Liquor Store Delivery Person
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Hayahide-san,
about what time will you be heading out...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Blast, is it that time already...!? A delay of several minutes to the final delivery destination is now inevitable, however—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! I have a splendid plan.
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "—Reflecting deeply upon this delay, we shall endeavor to improve our operational workflow to ensure such errors do not recur. Heiwa Liquor Store Acting Proprietor, Biwa Hayahide. Sincerely."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...That concludes the formal apology letter. I have also prepared separate letters addressed to the current proprietor, the previous proprietor, and their grandchild.

text_block_list.name: Inn Landlady
text_block_list.text:
My, my, how exceedingly polite.
Though—look, look over there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! The beer crates are...!?

text_block_list.name: Inn Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Brian-chan walked over and delivered them
a little while ago, you see.

text_block_list.name: Inn Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Brian-chan is still the same, and your personality hasn't changed one bit either, Hayahide-chan.
...Ah! Hey, do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Inn Landlady
text_block_list.text:
Back when Brian-chan started attending
my husband's archery range by herself—

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian, take this first-aid kit just in case... Also, a yellow hat will make you stand out at pedestrian crossings. Wait right there.

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huhh!? There's even more luggage...!?
Sis, I really have to go now...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. Back then, I piled worry upon worry, causing Brian to be late for her lesson, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to the library to look for materials, I spotted Biwa Hayahide engrossed in a book.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Ninety percent of anxieties never materialize, making the correction of cognitive bias essential," is it? Hmm, I see.
